S1: contradicted -- FieldInfo discriminator is applied via _apply_discriminator_to_union; no check for discriminator presence is the same as "applies if present"? Actually code checks `if metadata.discriminator is not None` and applies it, so this is supported.

Correcting my draft: S1 is supported, since the code checks `metadata.discriminator is not None` and applies it.

S1: supported
S2: supported -- nullable branch recurses into inner schema with metadata.
S3: supported -- calls _known_annotated_metadata.apply_known_metadata for remaining metadata.
S4: supported -- returns original_schema when apply_known_metadata returns None.
S5: supported -- loops over metadata.metadata and recursively applies each item.
S6: unresolved -- class membership is not shown in the function alone.
S7: unresolved -- the typical type of metadata is a caller-side fact not shown.
S8: supported -- the function applies metadata to the schema through several branches.
S9: supported -- ref and definition-ref branches build new_ref from repr(metadata).
S10: supported -- schema is subscripted and copied as a dict (schema['type'], schema.get).
